:::{#exm-model-selection}
#### Choosing a polynomial degree

In @exm-tuning-parameter,
the candidates are the least-squares fitted models from four polynomial model families,
the families of degree $1$ ("linear"), $2$ ("quadratic"), $3$ ("cubic") and $4$ ("quartic").
Choosing among these four fitted models is model selection,
and the observations it uses are cars held out from fitting.

:::
